messages.subject: Random forest/Classification trees
parts:
Hi all,
I am trying to use random forest for classification/machine learning.

In brief, my issue is a follows:

Prediction = Predictors
level 1 =  X1+X2+...+X14
level 2 =  Y1+Y2+...+Y14
level 3 =  A1+A2+...+A14
level 4 =  B1+B2+...+B14

If my fit has only two levels the accuracy is 100% but if I include 3 levels it reduces to ~90% and ~80 if I include all levels. 

I tried combining all random forest fits but accuracy is not improving. Can someone guide me on how to improve the prediction efficiency? 
I am hoping that someone has used random forests for their research and give some insights. 

Thanking you in anticipation. 

-- 
Regards,
Shriram (Shri)
PhD Student, Chemical Engineering
